categories.main_business_segments: Wuhan Dameng Database Company Limited primarily develops and provides database software products, cluster software, cloud computing and big data products, and integrated database machines. Their offerings include relational and non-relational databases, distributed databases, cloud-native databases, and comprehensive data lifecycle management solutions. The company also delivers data and industry-specific solutions, operation and maintenance services, and hardware-software integrated database machines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes original innovation with independently developed core technologies in database management systems, cluster technology, cloud computing, and integrated database machines. Key technologies include SQL optimization, storage management, high-security native databases, high-performance transaction processing, distributed and shared storage cluster technologies, graph-relational hybrid storage, data integration, and intelligent database operation and maintenance. Production involves software development and hardware assembly for integrated machines, with rigorous quality control and optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Dameng serves large and medium-sized enterprises, government agencies, and key industries such as finance, telecommunications, energy, transportation, and public security. Their products support digital transformation and information system upgrades in these sectors. The company collaborates with top independent software vendors (ISVs) and targets markets requiring high security, reliability, and performance in database solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant market presence in North China, East China, Central China, South China, Southwest, and Northwest regions. It also has subsidiaries in major Chinese cities including Wuhan, Beijing, Shanghai, Sichuan, Jiangsu, Shenzhen, and Chongqing. There is mention of exploring markets in Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and overseas regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dameng operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the database software supply chain. It develops proprietary database software and integrated hardware-software products, sells software licenses, and provides technical services and solutions directly to end customers and through channel partners. The company also procures hardware components for its integrated database machines from external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes autonomous innovation, focusing on advancing core database technologies such as distributed databases, cloud-native architectures, multi-model data engines, and AI integration. It invests heavily in R&D, collaborates with universities and research institutes, and pursues new product development in areas like HTAP, blockchain databases, and intelligent database operation. Dameng aims to lead in technology from follower to innovator and build a robust domestic database ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Dameng generates revenue primarily through software product licensing, sales of integrated database machines, data and industry solution projects, and operation and maintenance service contracts. Sales are conducted via direct sales and channel partners. The company also earns government subsidies and investment income from subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic database software provider in China, competing against international giants like Oracle and Microsoft. While international firms still dominate the market, Dameng has secured a strong position among domestic vendors, recognized for its independent innovation and growing market share. It is regarded as a key promoter of China's database industry development and has received multiple industry awards and recognitions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Dameng achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.044 billion, a 31.49% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 361.87 million, up 22.22%. The company completed its IPO in June 2024, significantly increasing total assets to RMB 3.787 billion and net assets to RMB 3.238 billion. R&D investment accounted for about 19.79% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth and innovation trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dameng emphasizes fully autonomous core technology development, offering a comprehensive full-stack database product portfolio with broad application scenarios. Its products feature high security, reliability, and performance, with certifications from national security centers. The company provides integrated hardware-software solutions (database machines) and intelligent operation and maintenance capabilities, supported by a nationwide service network and strong ecosystem partnerships, differentiating itself through innovation, service quality, and domestic control.
